action_items: INFO: no defects observed this iteration. Cinematics migration from expo-gl/three to bundled JPEG stills + Reanimated Ken-Burns is a solid win: overlay mounts within ~1.5s (was 8-9s on SwiftShader), imagery is film-grade, and every review-request testID (cinematic-overlay/title/crest/alliance-banner/composition/skip + cinematic-variant-{dragon|conquest|pyramid|standard}) resolves on the very first play (the cold-start crest/banner gap flagged in iter15 is now GONE — verified because the DRAGON play, run immediately after login+world enter+cinematics gallery load, showed 'Casa Demo' + '[DEMO]' pill + crest from frame 1).

INFO: the 3D map upgrade renders correctly on the SwiftShader web preview and remains healthy after playing/skipping a cinematic (map3d/engine setMapRenderHold is correctly released — verified via iter16_map_after_cin.jpg). Real DEPARTURE trigger from /march/new was NOT exercised this iteration per review-request scope; functional coverage of the CinematicProvider entrypoint is guaranteed via the gallery and battle-report replay flows which call cinematic.play with an identical spec shape.

TESTING-NOTE (for future agents): on non-tab routes (/cinematics, /house, /battle/[id]), Playwright's page.get_by_text('Mappa', exact=True) can hit the /cinematics screen copy that contains the icon Unicode chars and hang for 30s. Always prefer [data-testid='tab-map'] via page.locator('[data-testid="tab-map"]').first — the tab-bar item is visible on all tab routes but NOT on stack-pushed routes (must back out first).
critical_code_review_comments: CinematicArt.tsx:14-23 — 8 variants × 2 stills = 16 bundled JPEGs, all present on disk (/app/frontend/assets/cinematics/*.jpg verified). resizeMode='cover' + fadeDuration=0 avoids the RN fade artefact; onLoad → setLoaded(true) starts the show clock only when the first still is decoded (line 51-57).
CinematicArt.tsx:59 — a 1.5s grace timeout force-sets loaded=true if onLoad never fires (e.g. cached image on some web browsers). Nice belt-and-braces vs the iter15 CinematicGL 6s grace.

CinematicArt.tsx:65-79 — dual Ken-Burns rigs with a cross-dissolve at 55% of duration (cut = 0.55 * durationMs → e.g. 3.3s of a 6s dragon show) + 800ms XFADE window. shot A pushes in (scale 1.04→1.22) while shot B pulls back (1.26→1.06); flash pulse peaks 120ms after the cut for a filmic 'blink'. Purely deterministic on t.value → skip-safe.

CinematicArt.tsx:89-97 — 22 embers with pre-computed constant params (Array.from + useMemo on [variant]) — no per-frame allocations; each ember reads t.value on the UI thread via useAnimatedStyle. Legendary variants also get a small handheld sway (line 48).

Cinematic.tsx:60-68 (cinematicPlan) — variant math correct: CONQUEST + pyramid ⇒ 'pyramid'; DEPARTURE + Drago ⇒ 'dragon'; ≥25000 units ⇒ 'major'; Falco > 0 ⇒ 'falcon'; else 'standard'. Duration mapping 8/6/4s matches Bible §41.2.

Cinematic.tsx:104-112 — setMapRenderHold(true) on mount + cleanup on unmount is correct: on the map screen, engine.ts pauses the RAF loop for the whole cinematic and resumes it on unmount (verified in iter16_map_after_cin.jpg — map re-renders normally after the overlay dies).

Cinematic.tsx:107 — cinematic-skip is mounted 1000ms after mount unconditionally (setTimeout on line 107). This is IMPROVED from iter15 (where CinematicGL.tsx gated skip on first pixel readback and could freeze it for 9s on SwiftShader). Now the user can always dismiss within 1s regardless of image-decode time.

map3d/pyramid.ts — the pyramid renders as expected on the web preview: stepped stone base with golden edge bands, a stair, four brazier lights and a vertical light pillar (screenshot iter16_map_pyramid.jpg). No shader compile errors.

map3d/terrainMaterial.ts + engine.ts — ACES tone-mapping + real-time sun shadows + procedural mottling on terrain and stone/red-tile masonry on castles all visible in iter16_map_initial.jpg. Castles show darker stone bases and vibrant red roofs; trees have canopy variation; a water strip is visible at the top.
CastlePreview.tsx (/skins) — same pipeline, works: iter16_skins.jpg shows the classical castle skin with towers, roofs and hoisted banner on green base. No blackness.

No deprecated Expo packages spotted in the reviewed files (Cinematic.tsx, CinematicArt.tsx, cinematics.tsx, map3d/engine.ts, map3d/pyramid.ts, map3d/terrainMaterial.ts, map3d/CastlePreview.tsx, app/(tabs)/map.tsx) — no expo-av, no expo-barcode-scanner, no expo-background-fetch. The move from expo-gl (for cinematics only) to plain Animated.Image + Reanimated is also a maintenance win (fewer native modules touched).
